title: URGENT CIRCULAR: Rescheduling of CS201 Midterm Exam
inputText:
CIRCULAR - OFFICE OF THE CONTROLLER OF EXAMINATIONS
Date: 2026-10-02
To: All CS201 Students

Subject: Rescheduling of CS201 Midterm Theory Examination.

Due to the IEEE International Computing Symposium being hosted in Hall 301, the CS201 Midterm Theory Examination previously scheduled on October 20, 2026 has been officially RESCHEDULED to 2026-10-27.

Revised Exam Details:
- Date: 2026-10-27
- Time: 14:00 - 16:00
- Location: Main Auditorium

All students must make note of this revised schedule.
